name: archi-ai-labs
description: Claude Code plugins by Archi AI Labs

plugins.name: trim-kit
plugins.description: A small toolkit for setting up and maintaining Claude Code configuration per project. No hooks, no agents, no MCP - plain skills only.

plugins.name: docs-kit
plugins.description: Two layers in one plugin. Docs: scaffold a three-layer structure (docs-init), reconcile it with what a session actually did (docs-sync), validate it deterministically (docs-check), render an HTML read model (docs-render), and turn settled decisions into a delegation prompt (brief). Crew: run tickets in parallel over a fixed pool of executor worktrees — one ticket, one branch, one named session — and close them out from the commit trailer (crew-init, crew-status). Four warn-only hooks watch Architecture edits, undocumented code changes, resource locks and unexplained questions.

plugins.name: now-board
plugins.description: A 30-second board per repo — what you were doing and the next action, what is waiting on your decision, what is waiting on someone else, and what is queued — written to a gitignored NOW.json/NOW.md so returning to a project after a context switch does not start with re-reading the diff. Also lists stray worktrees and scans every project at once. Ships a second, macOS-only skill that installs the NOW dashboard, which reads every board you have written into one page.
